name: wire
description: The Wire Framework — AI-accelerated data platform delivery for the full lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, enablement

telemetry.title: Usage telemetry
telemetry.description: Send one usage event per Wire command (command name, release, what started it, Wire version, machine and repository identifiers). Never prompt text or file contents. WIRE_TELEMETRY=false also turns it off.

metrics.title: Execution-log metrics
metrics.description: Fill the Duration, Tokens and Cost cells of each Wire command's execution_log.md row from measured usage. WIRE_METRICS=false also turns it off.
